definitions.explanation: The feeling or state of being surprised or amazed by something unexpected.

examples.japanese: {驚|おどろ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せなかった→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{驚|おどろ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{驚|おどろ}き⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her success was a big surprise.

notes:
{驚|おどろ}き is a noun meaning surprise or astonishment. It comes from the verb ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be surprised).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {驚|おどろ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (cannot hide one's surprise)
- {驚|おどろ}きの〜 (~ing, surprising ~)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{驚|おどろ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel surprised at ~)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{驚|おどろ}き (a big surprise)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {驚|おどろ}き⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦もも→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (an expression of great surprise - colloquial)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be surprised)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦びっくり→びっくり：03003_bikkuri⟧: casual surprise
- {驚|おどろ}き: slightly more formal
- ⟦{驚愕|きょうがく}→驚愕：08685_kyougaku⟧: strong astonishment (very formal)
